content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.E., or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Geoinformatics/GIS, Biomedical Engineering, Environmental Data Science, Signal Processing or related disciplines. Postdoctoral Research Fellow: PhD (completed or near completion) in Political Science, Development Studies, Environmental Studies, Human Geography or closely related field; within 5 years of PhD completion.

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): ₹37,000 per month + HRA Postdoctoral Research Fellow: Around Rs. 1,00,000/-

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BITS Pilani to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow / Postdoctoral Research Fellow posts is 15th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: For the JRF position, candidates need a B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.E., or M.Sc. in relevant fields like Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, etc.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow position is approximately Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application screening followed by an online or offline interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. Which city is the job located in?
faq.answer: The job is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are contractual positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum qualification for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a completed PhD or be near completion in Political Science, Development Studies, Environmental Studies, Human Geography, or a related field.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.
